title: Quality Assurance Analyst (Syteline, ERP, Manual Testing)

Validate new features, enhancements, and defect fixes before release. Reproduce customer-reported issues and verify corrective actions. Develop and maintain regression test suites. Participate in release validation and application-readiness activities. Collaborate with Development, Business Analysts, Product Support, and Product Management teams. Contribute to test automation and regression automation initiatives where appropriate. Participate in Agile ceremonies and continuous QA process improvements. Basic Qualifications: 3-4 years of experience in software testing or Quality Assurance. Strong hands-on experience with manual testing and functional testing methodologies. Experience with defect tracking/test management tools such as Jira, Zephyr, or Azure DevOps . Working knowledge of SQL for data validation. Familiarity with test automation concepts and tools. Understanding of SDLC, Agile, and Scrum practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. title: Marketing and Operations Analyst
description: Job role We are looking for a Operations and Growth Analyst who will support the organization across reviewing business operations, team performance analytics, MIS reporting, QMS records and process improvement to drive business towards growth. The role requires an analytical and detail-oriented individual who can work with business data, coordinate with multiple teams, maintain operational records, monitor KPIs, identify gaps, and support management in improving business processes. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, trackers, documentation, and cross-functional teams and should have a strong ownership mindset. Roles & Responsibilities Monitor and coordinate day-to-day business and operational activities across different functions and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and action items. Prepare and maintain MIS reports, dashboards, trackers, and management reports related to business operations, team performance, finance, and QMS. Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze data from Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Quality, Product, and other functions to provide accurate and timely operational insights. Track team-wise and individual KPIs , targets, productivity, task completion, utilization, and performance against defined goals, and highlight gaps to the respective HOD/management. Support the management team in weekly/monthly business performance reviews by preparing data, reports, presentations, and action trackers. Maintain and monitor QMS documentation, SOPs, records, forms, revision history, audit-related documents, CAPA trackers, and compliance records in coordination with the Quality team. Support preparation for internal and external audits by coordinating required documents, records, evidence, and action-item follow-ups. Track QMS observations, CAPAs, corrective actions, and compliance activities and follow up with responsible team members for timely closure. Prepare Quotations/PIs /Invoices and coordinate with the stakeholders for invoices, payments, receivables, expenses, vendor/customer records, reconciliations, and other business-related financial trackers . Maintain accurate business and finance-related data and identify discrepancies or missing information for correction. Monitor operational expenses, pending payments, receivables, and other assigned financial/business metrics and provide regular updates. Identify process gaps, delays, duplication, inefficiencies, and operational risks and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution. Develop and improve Excel/Google Sheets-based trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems to improve visibility and accountability. Support process automation and digitization of repetitive operational and reporting activities. Maintain action trackers from management/HOD meetings and follow up with respective owners until closure. Coordinate with different departments to ensure timely completion of cross-functional activities and escalate critical delays. Support management in data-driven decision-making by providing accurate analysis, trends, and operational insights. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of business, employee, financial, customer, and operational information. Perform other business operations and analytical activities assigned by management. Qualifications 0–2 years of experience in Business Operations, Business Analysis, Operations, MIS, Quality, Finance Operations, or a similar role. B.E./B.Tech/MBA candidates preferred , especially candidates with an analytical or engineering mindset. Freshers with strong Excel, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills may also be considered. Candidates who demonstrate career stability, ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to work across functions will be preferred. Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Food provided Health insurance Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst- Government Projects
description: About Niti Aide Niti Aide builds AI and digital solutions for government: dashboards for senior officers, citizen-facing WhatsApp and web assistants, and monitoring platforms for departments and public bodies. We are empanelled with NISG and work with bodies such as HMWSSB, GHMC, and TGMSIDC across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We’re a small, founder-led team, and the work you bring in is the work we build. The role This is not a desk BA job. You’ll spend 3–4 days a week inside government offices, meeting officers, understanding how departments actually run, and finding problems worth solving. Then you’ll work with our product and tech team to turn those problems into solutions, and follow through until the work order is signed. You’ll own a set of departments end to end, from first meeting to signed work order, and you’ll be measured on it. What you’ll do Visit government offices regularly and build working relationships with officers and their teams Run discovery conversations: how the department works, what data it has, which reviews it faces, and where it struggles Turn those conversations into clear one-page problem statements Co-design solutions with the founders and tech team Present concept notes, proposals and demos to officers Track tenders, RFPs, empanelments and nomination opportunities Follow up persistently on meetings, file movement and approvals until the work order comes through Maintain a clean pipeline of departments, stakeholders and next steps Who we’re looking for MBA (2024–26 batch), or 1–3 years in B2B, institutional or field sales, or consulting Confident, well-presented and mature in conversation. You should be able to hold your own with senior officers, and we’ll coach you on the rest. A structured thinker who can turn a messy one-hour meeting into a crisp problem statement Fluent in Telugu, with strong spoken and written English Comfortable with Docs, Sheets and slides, and curious about AI.
